note: Florida Forest Service overflow camp; gravel sites off Keri Road (CR 832).
summary: Confirmed no electric/water, 6 RV-or-tent sites to 40 ft (pull-in gravel), reservable on ReserveAmerica up to 11 months incl. same day, $9.09 fee unchanged; added year-round season, no potable water, hunting-season-only portable toilets, generators allowed. No 4WD, tent-only or hunt-season-only restriction stated; a 23-ft motorhome fits. Note trimmed.
flags: Phone: 863-612-0776 is the number the booking page gives ('For reservations please contact (863) 612-0776'); the forest's FDACS page lists the office at (863) 302-6650.
